svg.title: Liquid cooling manifold in a rack
svg.desc: Rear-view cutaway of a server-rack section with direct liquid cooling: supply and return manifold pipes in the rear corner, cut at the top, each node tray holding a board with two cold plates in series linked by hoses to the manifolds through quick-disconnect couplings.
